title: fix(plugin-approvals)!: the administrator override never approves a request its actor submitted
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the administrator override is a runtime lever that no published skill teaches; content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx states the rule

**BREAKING** for an administrator who submitted a pending approval request and holds no slot on its step: the approve door answers `403 FORBIDDEN`, and an override reassign that would hand the request to its submitter answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`. The changeset carries the ADR-0087 disposition (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:管理员越权(override)永不批准自己提交的审批请求,也不能被用作给自己拿到审批席位的手段:提交人本人做的越权改派,凡是本人能承接的目标(本人 id、任意大小写的邮箱、本人担任的任何岗位,含与他人共任的岗位)一律拒绝;别的管理员越权改派给提交人(id、邮箱或仅本人担任的岗位)同样拒绝。驳回、撤回仍归提交人;非提交人的管理员越权照旧。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决 2026-11-17 选项 B:保留越权,但提交人不能借越权批准自己的请求。
- 风险与回滚:管理员审批自己提交、且自己不在审批人名单上的请求,现在返回 403;上述越权改派返回 400。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`(`decideNode` 新拒绝分支、`assertReassignTargetIsNotSubmitter`、`slotsName`、`attachViewers`),`sys-approval-request.object.ts`(Approve 的 `visible` 谓词),`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/approval-override-audit.test.ts src/exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts`,预期全部通过,含 "the override never approves its actor's own request" 与 "the override reassign and the submitter" 两组。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Maintainer ruling 2026-11-17, option B: the #3424 administrator override stays, never approves a request its actor submitted, and is never the means by which its actor takes a slot on their own request.

- **Approve.** `ApprovalService.decideNode` refuses an approval admitted only through the override (the actor holds no slot, so `via_override` would be `true`) when the actor submitted the request, with `403 FORBIDDEN`, before any write, whatever the step's `excludeSubmitter` says. The refusal is the shape the `excludeSubmitter` check already uses.
- **Reassign.** `assertReassignTargetIsNotSubmitter` also runs for a reassign admitted only through the override, whatever `excludeSubmitter` says:
  - whoever makes it, a target naming the request's submitter (their user id, or their email in any letter case) or a position only they hold in the request's organization answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`;
  - when the submitter makes the override reassign themselves, every target they could act under is refused: their id, their email, and any position they hold, one they share with others included;
  - a different administrator may still reassign to a position the submitter shares with others, and a slot holder's own hand-off under `excludeSubmitter` keeps its only-holder rule: there the submitter is one holder among others on a slate someone else chose, which is `excludeSubmitter`'s question.
  - An email target is compared with the submitter's address in any letter case, as the decision door admits a named email, so the check is never narrower than the identity the decision door admits. Under `excludeSubmitter` its existing text is unchanged.
- **Unchanged, and pinned.** The submitter-administrator's reject and recall; an administrator's override of a request they did not submit (`via_override: true`); a submitter who holds a real slot, which stays `excludeSubmitter`'s question.
- **Viewer flag.** The `viewer` block gains `can_override_approve` beside `can_override`: `can_override`, except on a request the viewer submitted. `can_override` is unchanged; nothing is removed. `sys_approval_request` declares the leaf under `attachedOnRead.viewer`, and the `approval_approve` action's override arm reads it, so the Approve control is not offered where the server refuses it. Reject, Reassign and Recall keep reading `can_override`. `ApprovalRequestRow.viewer` in `@objectstack/spec/contracts` declares the flag as optional, and its `can_override` docblock states the rule.
- **Console.** No `ui/` change is needed: the Console decides Approve's visibility from the served `visible` predicate, and its override label (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/approvalOverride.ts`, `actionAdmittedByOverride`) matches the `can_override` text in the new arm, so Approve keeps its "Override Approve" framing for an administrator who did not submit the request.
- **Docs** (`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`):
  - the rule, at the decide door and in the admin-override callout, with the reassign targets above;
  - the way out of a stuck own request: reassign it, or recall it and send the record for approval again. A slate that still names no one opens on the organization's administrators under `admin_rescue`. Without `excludeSubmitter` a submitter who is one of them is on that slate and may approve as an ordinary approver; with it, another administrator decides;
  - the new viewer flag, and which flags the actions on the raw table read;
  - the slate's approvers after an override decision. One with no other read on the request reads `404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`. One who keeps a read (they acted on it, submitted it, or read it through the object's `approvalsVisibleToReaders`) still sees it decided, and a decision answers `409 INVALID_STATE`.

## Tests

- `plugin-approvals` `approval-override-audit.test.ts`, top-level describe "the override never approves its actor's own request" (11 cases):
  - platform and tenant administrator approvals of their own request are refused with nothing written, with `excludeSubmitter` false and true;
  - reject and recall stay theirs;
  - an override reassign to the submitter by id and email, by the submitter and by another administrator, is refused with the slate unchanged;
  - the same, with the submitter's email in another letter case, on a store that matches emails case-insensitively;
  - controls: a non-submitter administrator's override approval (`via_override: true`), an override reassign to someone else, slot holders approving their own requests (`via_override: false`), and the served viewer flags per actor.
- `exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts`, on a real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` with a real position directory, describe "the override reassign and the submitter" (5 cases):
  - the submitter-administrator's override reassign is refused for their id, their email, a position only they hold, and a position they share;
  - the shared position is refused with `excludeSubmitter` on too;
  - a different administrator's override reassign to a position only the submitter holds is refused;
  - controls: a different administrator may reassign to the shared position, and the submitter-administrator may reassign to a position they do not hold.
- `action-predicate-sparse-face.test.ts`: a submitter who is also an override actor is offered reject, reassign and recall, never the override approve; fixtures carry the new leaf.
- `sys-approval-request.object.test.ts`: Approve's override arm reads `can_override_approve`, never the bare `can_override`.
- `sys-approval-request-viewer.conformance.test.ts`: a new caller shape (an override actor on their own request); a shape is marked by a set of leaves.
- Door level, through the real approvals routes on a booted app (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-override-composite-pin.dogfood.test.ts`, describe "the override never approves its actor's own request, through the approvals routes", 5 cases):
  - the submitter-administrator's approve answers 403 and records nothing, their viewer reads `can_override_approve: false`, and the served Approve predicate evaluates false;
  - the override reassign to the submitter (id, email, and on a member's request) answers 400 and leaves the slate;
  - reject and recall answer 200;
  - controls: a non-submitter administrator's override approval answers 200 audited `via_override: true`, after which the slate's approver reads 404; a slot holder approving their own request answers 200 with `via_override: false`.
  - The existing composite pin's exact viewer shape gains the new leaf.
- Exact viewer-shape assertions in `approval-service.test.ts`, `record-reader-visibility.test.ts`, `record-reader-opt-in.integration.test.ts` and `request-read-gate.integration.test.ts` carry the new leaf.
- Ablation, one per behaviour, each red then restored (counts under Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- Surface beyond `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/**` and the docs page:
  - `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`: one optional member and its docblock, so the TypeScript contract names the served flag and its `can_override` text stays true;
  - the dogfood composite pin file: the door-level pins, and its exact viewer shape.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: the served viewer block and the TypeScript contract each gain one field, and the approve and reassign doors refuse more callers.
- **Follow-up owed** (one card, for the seat to file): descriptions of the viewer block that still name three leaves, or still tie Approve to `can_override`:
  - the `attachedOnRead` docblock in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`;
  - the comment over the approvals entry in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/account.app.ts`;
  - the `approvalOverride.ts` docblock under `ui/`;
  - the verify text of the approvals entries in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`.
  Each is text only; behaviour reads the served predicate.
